name: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
summary: Count the seconds in the clock at the end of the taskbar.
what: Sets ShowSecondsInSystemClock to 1 for your account, the same value the checkbox Show seconds in system tray clock under Settings, Time and language, Date and time writes. Revert puts back what was there before.
benefit: The taskbar clock shows seconds, which helps when you time something or check that the clock is right.
risk: None. Windows labels the option as using more power.
advice: A matter of taste. Skip it on a laptop if battery life matters to you.
facts: Windows labels the option as using more power
Revert puts back what was there before
